title: Rename a struct field across a C library, its tests, README and CSV output
prompt: In this C project, rename the field `qty` of `struct item` to `quantity` everywhere it is used: the struct, every access (->, ., designated initializers, macros, offsetof), the test driver, the README, and the CSV report column (its header and the column name report_field_offset accepts). `struct order_line` also has a `qty` field: that one stays as it is. Do not keep the old name as an alias. Run the tests when you are done.
notes: Added 2026-11-26 so C crawl docs can show a benefit (crawl on/off A/B). Tests build with gcc from PATH (devkitPro msys2 gcc 15 on the eval host). Decoy: struct order_line.qty, mixed with item->qty on the same lines in order.c.
